messages:
incident_bot: INCIDENT: High capacity pressure in dedicated reservation 'reserved-eu-1' (95% GPU util). Severity: high. Affected tenant: NovaHealth (enterprise_reserved). Queue growth > 600. Pager routed to @oncall_marc.

sre_anna: saw alerts too. Top-line: queue spike started ~1866003200, sustained. A lot of long-running inference sessions + some batch rerank jobs.

oncall_marc: I\'m on it. marc here — grabbing logs and checking autoscaler/placement. @ml_infra_jay can you check autoscaler health and cloud API errors?

ml_infra_jay: looking. quick summary: autoscaler attempted scale actions but cloud provider returned repeated 429/503 on instance create calls. Also we hit configured max_replicas = 40 for this pool. Attaching recent controller log snippet:

```
ERROR 1866003260 autoscaler.go:214 scaleup failed: provider api error 429 Too Many Requests (rate limit) request_id=xyz-123
WARN  1866003305 autoscaler.go:198 max_replicas reached (40) for pool reserved-eu-1
INFO  1866003312 queue_monitor.go:87 queue_length=612 inflight=39 avg_latency=2.8s
```

ml_infra_jay: tl;dr: two limits: provider-side rate limiting (slowing new nodes) + our pool max cap. If we increase max_replicas, provider rate limits still blocking fast recovery.

eng_platform_leah: use-case specifics: NovaHealth has reserved capacity but is hitting soft isolation issues due to a noisy tenant (internal-research) running large beam searches. We should avoid evicting NovaHealth reserved allocations. Proposals: (1) immediate per-tenant concurrency throttle on internal-research, (2) evict/terminate non-reserved batch jobs in the pool, (3) enable-hosted-fallback for NovaHealth sessions for 30m while we recover.

oncall_marc: doing (2) now — evicting non-reserved jobs. running command: `rictl job cancel --pool reserved-eu-1 --filter "priority=low or reservation=none"`

se_tom: I can flip hosted fallback for NovaHealth via customer routing. Endpoint: `routing.set_fallback --customer novahealth --target hosted-rapid --ttl 1800` — want confirm before execute (this will route new requests to hosted API; existing in-flight will remain).

acct_emma: please let me know before any fallback so I can prep the customer message. They\'re on a 9am call with ops. If we route to hosted we should note potential latency/cost differences.

ml_infra_jay: evictions started at 1866003400. Cancel of low-priority jobs freed ~6 GPUs. Queue dropped from 612 -> 280 over 3m. However autoscaler still throttled by cloud rate limit; creating nodes spaced out.

eng_platform_leah: I\'m applying a temporary per-tenant concurrency limit on the noisy tenant: `rictl tenant update internal-research --concurrency 4 --apply-now` — this should cut their burst. Also bumping pool max_replicas to 60 as emergency. Command: `rictl pool update reserved-eu-1 --max-replicas 60` (will not bypass cloud rate limit but allows autoscaler to scale if provider allows).

oncall_marc: increased max_replicas at 1866003502. Also opened a support ticket with cloud provider for rate limit emergency (ticket 98765). Vendor replied: "processing, ETA 15-30m for soft quota lift".

pm_raj: PM note — NovaHealth SLAs: latency and availability for reserved endpoints. Need to prepare customer-facing incident note. @acct_emma, if we fallback we should provide clear expectation and ETA.

se_tom: I enabled hosted fallback at 1866003578 for new requests only. I did not migrate in-flight sessions.

acct_emma: notified NovaHealth at 1866003590 — short message: "We detected capacity pressure impacting your reserved pool. We have enabled a temporary fallback to our hosted endpoints for new requests to prevent errors while we recover. We expect queue to return to baseline within 30-45 minutes. Ops will update every 10 minutes." They acknowledged and asked for ETA updates.

ml_infra_jay: cloud provider increased rate limit at 1866003705. Autoscaler started provisioning additional nodes; new nodes becoming healthy at 1866003800+. Queue decreased to ~85 by 1866003890.

sre_anna: monitoring: CPU/GPU util trending down. Throttles applied to internal-research still in effect. No customer error bursts reported in the last 5m for NovaHealth (post-fallback).

eng_platform_leah: actions taken summary: evicted low-priority jobs (6 GPUs), applied per-tenant throttle to internal-research, bumped pool max_replicas, enabled hosted fallback for NovaHealth, opened cloud support ticket.

pm_raj: postmortem owner: @eng_platform_leah. Timeline + RCA + mitigation playbook update required. Please include follow-ups: (A) revisit autoscaler backoff/retry strategy for provider 429s, (B) tighter noisy-neighbor detection & automated throttles, (C) consider burst buffer pool for enterprise fallbacks.

oncall_marc: current status at 1866004233: partial mitigation successful. Queue 85, pool util 72%, no active customer errors for NovaHealth. Keeping pager on for the next 45m. Escalate to eng-sre if we see re-increase.

acct_emma: will send customer summary + link to incident doc.

sre_anna: adding logs and command history to the incident doc now.

incident_bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: State=partial_mitigated. Severity downgraded to medium. Next update scheduled in 10m or on-change."
